subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose operator-authored `agents.list[].description` values to caller agents that already pass the subagent allowlist, and what normalization or length bound should apply?
rationale: The config field exists, but projecting arbitrary authored text into model-visible discovery output establishes a public tool contract and prompt-size policy requiring explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions only for authorized agents, with a documented maximum length and blank-value omission.

options.title: Expose verbatim descriptions
options.body: Return the full configured string for authorized agents and treat prompt growth as an operator-managed consequence.

options.title: Keep metadata config-only
options.body: Do not expose descriptions through `agents_list`, leaving orchestration catalogs in prompts or workspace files.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions only for authorized agents, with a documented maximum length and blank-value omission.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most directly connects this person to `agents_list`, multi-agent routing, and the allowlist boundary controlling discovery.
